summary: Smite entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Smite
entries.definitive_edition: Current official PC legacy SMITE client/service state

primary.version: Current official legacy SMITE client/service state
primary.why: SMITE is a live-service third-person MOBA, and the PC client gives the best capture/settings route for the original game. SMITE 2 is a separate sequel, so the original entry should archive the current legacy-service state rather than merging the two.
primary.how_to_play: Use the official PC client or Steam route if available. Record date, patch, account, owned gods/skins, mode, matchmaking/server status, cross-play/platform state, and whether SMITE 2 was separately checked.

secondary.what_to_play: Compare only if documenting console account or performance differences.
secondary.why: The service/account state matters more than replaying every platform.

entries.remaster_caveats: Archive by date, patch, account, owned content, and service status; do not merge with SMITE 2.
